facts.text: The 7th Session of the India–Egypt Joint Trade Committee was co-chaired by Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal and Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt Dr. Mohamed Farid Saleh on 15 November 2026.
Both sides reviewed developments in bilateral trade and agreed to work towards achieving a target of USD 12 billion in bilateral trade.
Bilateral merchandise trade during April–September 2026 stood at USD 5.04 billion, registering growth of 64 per cent over the corresponding period of the previous year.

facts.text: According to the latest estimates, India's total horticulture production is expected to reach 3,869.15 lakh tonnes in 2025-26, an increase of 161.77 lakh tonnes, or 4.36%, over the 3,707.38 lakh tonnes recorded in 2024-25.

Fruit production projected to increase by 4.60% Fruit production is estimated to rise from 1,176.49 lakh tonnes in 2024-25 to 1,230.66 lakh tonnes in 2025-26, an increase of 54.18 lakh tonnes or 4.60%.
Vegetable production expected to reach 2,272.68 lakh tonnes Farmers have also registered encouraging growth in vegetable cultivation.
